basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old university student from Toronto, Canada, majoring in Computer Science. I've been a gamer since my early teens and have a particular passion for MOBA games like League of Legends. Besides gaming, I enjoy exploring new music genres and occasionally dabble in digital art. I'm single and usually online during late evenings after classes and on weekends. I work part-time at a local electronics store, which helps fuel my tech and gaming interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge in gaming, particularly League of Legends, comes from years of playing and watching professional tournaments. I've also spent a lot of time on YouTube learning strategies and studying gameplay. My interest in computer science has provided me with analytical skills that I often apply in games.
